scope: Old v3 cap-absent server only: AB followed by BA. Budget-v4 excluded.

method.csv: nvidia-smi500ms polling; actual cadence retained per GPU/window
method.time_alignment: Parse GPU timestamp as UTC, verify first sample is within one second after recorded runner ready_epoch
method.phase_selection: Per-row timestamp in half-open[phase.start_epoch,phase.end_epoch), separately for each GPU
method.statistics: Unweighted mean/min/max/median of available point samples; not time-weighted kernel utilization or occupancy
method.prefill_extra_windows: Cold100k request.start_epoch through start_epoch+clientTTFT; includes API/admission plus prefill and first-token work, not exact device prefill interval

limitations: 5s baseline provides only9samples per GPU; internal utilization averaging may straddle phase edges.
GPU utilization measures sampled busy duty, not fraction of SMs occupied or achieved compute/bandwidth. Low utilization does not prove no work or identify CPU/PCIe waits.
No power-limit value, clock-throttle-reason counters, CPU profiling, PCIe traffic, per-kernel timing or critical-path trace was collected.
GPU7 hosts final model stage and per-slot draft work; scalar device metrics cannot isolate draft kernels from other GPU7 work.
Only two runs per flag, one nominal short C4 synthetic workload. Results are descriptive and not a tail SLO.
Old thinking-budget continuation rereading differs by arm; mixed/recovery effects are not solely draft compute costs.

findings.gpu7_load: In both5s baselines GPU7 util73.78%off versus85.0%on; devices0-6 roughly42-50%with similar values across flags. More GPU7 busy time is consistent with added draft work, but does not establish critical-path bottleneck.
findings.gpu7_clock_power: Baseline mean SM off1798.3/1776.7MHz versus on1741.7/1743.3MHz. Power remains247.3-249.7W. Consistent load-dependent boost reduction; no power throttle reason/limit was measured.
findings.thermal: Baseline GPU7 mean65.2-65.6C across all4arms; recovery67.2-67.7C. Similar temperatures with repeatable flag-dependent clocks do not support substantial between-arm thermal drift as the main explanation.
findings.mixed: Mixed includes long admissions and budget continuations; averages combine changing active stages. Lower mean utilization cannot identify idle cause.
findings.deployment: These readings do not reverse the legacy correctness/performance findings or justify deployment; corrected captrue/captrue experiment stays separate.
